isolation: Temporary profile, bare settings, explicit session plugin directory; no installation/auth/credentials change

advice.message: This README has no line that installs "ai-sapiens-dev" from a marketplace. Add the install line, which works in one step on Claude Code 2.1.275 or later. Validate the folder that holds its marketplace.json to have <owner>/<repo> filled in, and the name its marketplace lists it under.

findings.title: License missing
findings.message: This plugin has no LICENSE file and plugin.json has no `license`. The directory requires one of them.
findings.fix: Add a LICENSE file to the plugin folder, or set `license` (an SPDX id) in plugin.json. A LICENSE at the repository root also counts for a plugin in a sub-folder.

findings.title: No icon
findings.message: No icon found in the plugin. The validator looked for `icon` in plugin.json and for a file at .claude-plugin/icon.png or .svg, assets/icon.png or .svg, or a similar path.
findings.fix: Add a square PNG to the plugin folder at .claude-plugin/icon.png, or set `icon` in plugin.json to the path of a square PNG or JPEG in the plugin: 512 to 2048 px on each side, under 2 MB. SVG and WebP are not accepted. That file may become the listing icon only once: the first time the plugin is saved or submitted in the developer portal. Adding or changing it later does not change the icon.
